method: Built-in image generation; LinkedIn PNG resized to 400 × 400 using ImageMagick.
concept: Three coordinated streams of intelligence expressed as a geometric N. Navy, cyan and teal reflect Industrial AI, Robotics AI and Health AI.
logo_prompt: Design a NEW premium corporate logo for the exact company name 'Nordic Labs Tech Oy'. This company builds integrated, owner-controlled AI environments across industrial engineering, connected robotics and health-data systems. Brand idea: three coordinated streams of intelligence forming one dependable engineering core. Create a distinctive, beautifully balanced abstract N emblem from THREE substantial interlocking geometric paths, using deliberate negative space. The mark should hint at connected systems and Nordic architectural precision, without literal factory, robot, human, leaf, mountain, medical cross, brain or circuit-board illustrations. Flat vector-style design, minimal, confident, mature B2B technology identity. Main color deep midnight navy #071E2D; one restrained cyan #159CB3 path and one muted teal #24B7A3 path. Clean solid fills, no gradient, no texture, no 3D, no tiny nodes, no thin decorative lines. The silhouette must remain recognizable at 32 pixels and in monochrome. Professional custom brand mark, not a stock three-node networking icon. HORIZONTAL LOGO LOCKUP on plain white: symbol at left, exact text 'Nordic Labs Tech Oy' at right in refined dark-navy modern sans-serif with excellent kerning, medium-bold weight; all words clearly legible and spelled exactly. No tagline, no extra text, no mockup, no stationery, no border, no trademark symbol. Wide 3:1 layout with ample clear space and optical alignment. Deliver one polished logo option, not a sheet of options.
avatar_prompt: Create the square social-profile version of the supplied Nordic Labs Tech Oy logo. Preserve the EXACT emblem from the left side of the reference: navy angular N with the cyan upper diagonal bar and teal lower diagonal bar, identical geometry, proportions, angles, negative-space gaps and colors. Remove all wordmark text. Center only that same emblem on a pure white square canvas with generous equal margins, emblem occupying about 72% of the square. Clean sharp professional flat logo export, no redesign, no new strokes, no extra text, no gradients, no shadows, no mockup. This is the LinkedIn company page avatar, destined for a 400 by 400 pixel PNG.
